card.line: The Mount of Esau is the mountain land of Edom, where Esau's people lived. In Obadiah, God judges it, and in the end it comes under His kingdom.

moments.title: God judges the wise of Edom
moments.text: The LORD asks if He will not destroy the wise men and men of understanding in the mountains of Esau. Even the mighty men of Teman will be terrified and cut down.

moments.title: Israel will possess the mountains
moments.text: God promises that people from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau. Edom's land will be taken by the people of Israel.

moments.title: The kingdom belongs to the LORD
moments.text: Deliverers will go up Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau. The kingdom will belong to the LORD.
